scope: offline deterministic rules model; no human playtest or production changes

metric_definition.win_rate: percent; kills plus below-20-percent retreats reported separately
metric_definition.avg_rounds: successful runs only; null if no success
metric_definition.avg_remaining_hp: successful runs only; mean across original seats, downed seat counts as zero
metric_definition.random: uniform independent legal actions per living actor; not a model of new players
metric_definition.heuristic: solo_reasonable threshold20 and duo_cover fixture policies; one deterministic run each
metric_definition.retreat: only at round16, surviving party and boss/max strictly <20%; counted as success in model only
metric_definition.tie_break: fewest baseline changes, then unchanged heal28 per requested lever priority, then stable grid order

recommended.reason: strict16 only; minimum unweighted normalized interval distances for explicit A/B targets and duo8..11; ties prefer fewer baseline changes then unchanged healing per lever priority; model only
recommended.application_scope: repository source only; no deployment or human acceptance

assumptions.deviations: Actual optimal reference length, not assumed15; A/G/H type substitutions with self target. Illegal input is rejected and counted separately, not classified as combat defeat. Primary rate conservatively divides wins by all nominal variants; legal_rate excludes invalid.
assumptions.mistakes: Per living actor each round: p normal adaptive heuristic, otherwise uniformly any legal action including the normal choice; explicit synthetic error model, not measured player population.
assumptions.duo_reference: existing cover policy, not claimed exhaustive optimum; duo delta1 one slot/one seat, delta2 one slot in each seat
assumptions.ranking: retreat rows are reference-only, not eligible; equal weights for normalized A/B interval shortfalls plus duo round target; no hidden error fitting
